en.description: From either side of the pig's neck — rare and prized, nicknamed the "golden six taels." The fat is marbled evenly like snowflakes, giving tender, springy meat with a smooth, well-balanced bite.
The rib-eye cap between the shoulder and loin — only two pieces per pig. Frost-like marbling makes it a rare, exceptionally tender cut, also called the "gourmet's cut"; juicy, sweet and soft.
en.tip: Keep below 5°C in the coldest part of the fridge; use within 11 days unopened, or portion and freeze for longer.
Freeze on a tray first so they don't clump, then bag; cook straight from frozen.
Portion before freezing; thaw in the fridge, never on the counter.
Freeze sliced in a sealed bag; toast directly from frozen.
Airtight container in a cool, dark spot; a bay leaf helps deter bugs.
Cool, ventilated and dark; keep away from potatoes.
Dark and cool, never the fridge; store away from onions.
Cool, dark and airy; never refrigerate — cold turns them hard and off-flavored.
Use an open mesh or basket with airflow; avoid plastic bags.
Cupboard is fine while sealed; refrigerate after opening.
Cool, dark place away from the stove; reseal the cap tightly.

放冷藏內側而非門邊；開封後 5–7 天內喝完。

zh.description: 位於豬頸兩側，因稀少而珍貴，有「黃金六兩」之稱；油脂如雪花般均勻分布，肉質鮮嫩有彈性，入口滑順、口感適中。
zh.tip: 冷藏於 5℃ 以下最冷處；未拆封 14 天內食用，或分裝冷凍可放更久。

zh.description: 取自肩部與里肌之間的肋眼蓋肉，每頭豬僅能取出兩片；油花如霜降般分布，是極鮮嫩的稀有部位，有「老饕肉」之稱，肉質多汁鮮甜軟嫩。
zh.tip: 冷藏於 5℃ 以下最冷處；未拆封 11 天內食用，或分裝冷凍可放更久。
先平鋪冷凍定型再裝袋，避免黏在一起；可直接下鍋免解凍。

切片密封冷凍；可直接烘烤，免退冰。
密封置於陰涼避光處；放片月桂葉可防蟲。
通風、陰涼、避光；與馬鈴薯分開存放。
